# Freeze dry run on a SYNTHETIC hold-out stand-in (2026-10-16)

**Not a hold-out result and not a validity figure.** The stand-in was generated by `scripts/v1.3/synthetic-holdout.ts`
from the development reference set (`tests/fixtures/v1.3-reference`) into a directory outside the repository. No sealed
path was read. Method and results: `Docs/v1.3/freeze-runbook.md` §D.

- `neo4j/`: `holdout-run.ts --development-stand-in` on Neo4j 5.26.24 Community + APOC core 5.26.24, tool commit
  `c80a1716` (the runner and scorer code is unchanged after it on this branch).
- `cypher-interp/`: the engine cross-check, `--engine cypher-interp --determinism ../neo4j`: raw rows byte-identical.
- `synthetic-id-map.json`: the id map of the stand-in's provisional ddd id (FF-D01 -> FF-DT01).
- `freeze-check-dry-run.txt`: `freeze-check.ts --dry-run` on the branch tip (no answers applied).
- Stand-in tree: 331 files; runner hash `433f76f85e4aa8c901ce569cd1bcc2c71b275fcfa94b3ba6141f5c409e81baa6`,
  sealed-hashes method (as `v1.3-holdout/`) `35c42509e8d39daf2a304841b682db1499946b7dedb8af9f88a56182d3a9e0c3`.
  `synthetic-holdout.ts` regenerates it byte for byte.
- Planted miss: `clean-architecture/v01-syn-domain-imports-application-port` FF-S01 `src/domain/entities/Loan.ts ->
